SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, CONCAT(CONCAT(A.FOLDERNO , '-'), A.MONITORPOINTNAME) AS FOLDERNAME, B.PROJNO, B.PROJNAME, B.TESTORGNAME, B.TESTORGID, B.STATUS PROJECTSTATUS, B.CREATEDBYNAME AS PROJECTCREATEDBYNAME, B.ENTRUSTORGNAME, B.BIZCATEGORYID, B.BIZCATEGORYCODE, B.URGENT,B.ORGID,B.ORGNAME FROM T_EMC_FOLDER A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT B ON A.PROJID = B.ID) T
AND T.ORGID like #{orgId} + '%'
AND (T.RUNID IS NULL OR T.RUNID ='')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O, T_EMC_SUBCONTRACT_RECORD S WHERE O.ID = S.ORDERTASKID AND O.FOLDERID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'done' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.SUBCONTRACTORID IS NOT NULL)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK O WHERE O.FOLDERID = T.ID AND O.STATUS = 'done' AND O.ANALYSISTYPE = 'analysis' AND O.DATASHARING = '1')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE O.FOLDERID = T.ID AND (O.SAMPLEID IS NULL OR O.SAMPLEID = ''))
AND (CHARINDEX(',' + #{sampleUserId} + ',' , ',' + SAMPLEUSERID + ',') > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',' + #{sceneUserId} + ',' , ',' + SCENEUSERID + ',') > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',' + #{sampleUserId} + ',' , ',' + PLANSAMPLEUSERID + ',') > 0)
AND CHARINDEX(',' + #{sceneUserId} + ',' , ',' + SCENEUSERID + ',') > 0
AND (CHARINDEX(',' + #{sampleUserId} + ',' , ',' + SAMPLEUSERID + ',') > 0 OR CHARINDEX(',' + #{sampleUserId} + ',' , ',' + PLANSAMPLEUSERID + ',') > 0)
ORDER BY
T.FOLDERNO, T.ID DESC
